segments.ja314:1.1: Dujjīvitamajīvimha, ye sante [yesaṃ no (syā. ka.)] na dadamhase;
segments.ja314:3.1: Natthi anto kuto anto, na anto paṭidissati;
segments.ja314:3.3: Tadā hi pakataṃ pāpaṃ, mama tuyhañca mārisā [mārisa (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja314:4.1: Sohaṃ nūna ito gantvā, yoniṃ laddhāna mānusiṃ;
